note: The one builds store (_claude/builds/store.json). Reference: framework/plan/builds-store-core.mjs (validateStore is the contract), framework/spec/BUILDS.md. Step dependencies and claims: framework/core/build-pipeline.mjs, framework/spec/BUILD-PARALLEL.md.

dependsOn.note: the same list under the splitter's and the API's name; normalisation stores it as `after` (`after` wins when both are given). Never on disk: the store check refuses a stored `dependsOn`.

parallel.absent: auto: the planner may run the step in a parallel session when it has an explicit `after` list and no file clash
parallel.never: only the build's own session runs it, even when its dependencies are done (rebases, merges, releases, shared state)

files.note: an existing step field; two steps that share a file never run at once. A step whose files overlap a step with a live claim is held back (readySteps / fileClashes), and auto-queue skips a Pending build while a running build is on one of its files.

after.items: step ids of the same build
after.absent: implicitly sequential: the step waits for the previous step in the list (every build from before this contract, and every step the splitter does not mark)
after.empty: no dependency: the step may start as soon as the build runs
rules: an id must name a step of the same build (a missing id is dropped on normalisation and reported by the store check)
no cycles: a build whose `after` lists form a cycle is refused by the store check
a skipped step counts as done for the steps after it

fields.runId: the dispatch / run id of the session working the step (string, ≤ 80)
fields.slot: the agent-slots entry id of that session (string, ≤ 60)
fields.account: the Claude account it runs on (saved account name)
fields.branch: the branch the step is worked on: <build-branch>--s<n> for a parallel step, the build branch for a sequential one (string, ≤ 200)
fields.at: ISO: when the claim was taken
fields.model: the step's pinned model the session was launched on (Fable | Opus)
fields.expiresAt: ISO: at + the claim TTL; a claim past it is dead and the step is ready again

rules: a live claim (now < expiresAt) keeps the step out of readySteps
a done step never carries a claim: ticking a step releases it
a claim is never launched on a model higher than the step's pinned model (raise the step first)
